mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when GDP increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment above 8% signals economic weakness, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Returns remain positive when unemployment exceeds 8%.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE indicate economic stress, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: High FEDFUNDS in a tightening cycle leads to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in a tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates strong supply, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns do not increase with industrial production growth.

mechanism_narrative: Declining real consumption signals weak demand, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur with declining RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment and housing starts indicate economic strength, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur despite strong labor and housing.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts in late-cycle expansion predict positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite increased housing starts.
